verses.text: From Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ. To those who have received a faith as precious as ours, because our God and Saviour Jesus Christ is fair and good.
May God give you more and more of his kindness and peace, as you come to know God and Jesus our Lord.
By his divine power, God has given us everything we need to live a life that pleases him. We have it because we know Jesus, who called us by his own glory and goodness.
Through these he has given us his precious and very great promises. By them you can share in God's own nature, and escape from the rot in the world that comes from wrong desires.
For this very reason, try your hardest to add goodness to your faith. To goodness add knowledge.
To knowledge add self-control. To self-control add patience. To patience add a life that honours God.
To that add kindness to your brothers and sisters, and to kindness add love.
If you have these things, and they keep growing, they will stop you from being lazy or useless in knowing our Lord Jesus Christ.
Anyone who does not have them is short-sighted and blind. They have forgotten that their old sins were washed away.
So, brothers and sisters, work even harder to make sure God really has called and chosen you. If you do these things, you will never fall.
And you will be warmly welcomed into the kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, which lasts forever.
So I will always remind you about these things, even though you already know them and are standing firm in the truth you have.
I think it is right to keep reminding you, as long as I live in this tent, my body.
I know that I will soon leave this tent, as our Lord Jesus Christ has shown me.
I will do my best to make sure that you can always remember these things after I am gone.
When we told you about the power of our Lord Jesus Christ and his coming, we were not following clever made-up stories. We saw his greatness with our own eyes.
God the Father gave him honour and glory. The voice came to him from God's great glory, saying, "This is my Son, whom I love. I am very pleased with him."
We heard this voice come from heaven while we were with him on the holy mountain.
So we are even more sure of the message the prophets gave. You should pay attention to it, like a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day begins and the morning star rises in your hearts.
Most of all, you must understand this: no prophecy in the Scriptures came from the prophet's own ideas.
No prophecy ever came because a person wanted it. Prophets were people who spoke from God, as the Holy Spirit moved them.
